messages:
sasha: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a compact risk-check thread for onboarding two open models we want in the catalog: mitra-7b and echo-3b. Target: catalog beta rollout next Tue. Need owners to confirm: licensing, perf profile, infra capacity, and rollout guardrails. Who can own each?

mike: I can own infra capacity + deployment config. Will validate reserved slots and autoscale knobs by EOD tomorrow.

lina: I'll take perf profiling and quality smoke tests. Note: I need dataset access for evals (eng-platform) — pinging them separately.

omar: Legal quick check: initial SPDX scan coming up. If echo-3b has any non-commercial clauses we'll need a deeper review. I should have flag/no-flag within 24h.

tara: I'm tracking product acceptance criteria — we need latency SLOs + at least one prompt-set regression test before beta. I'll keep the acceptance checklist in the launch doc.

sasha: Thanks. I'll summarize owners then: infra = @mike, perf = @lina, legal = @omar, product acceptance = @tara. I'm adding a short checklist: 
- licensing clearance
- perf profile (p50/p95 token latency, tokens/sec)
- quality smoke (5 prompt categories)
- canary plan (traffic % + fallback model)
- monitoring hooks + eval alerts

mike: Putting up an infra PR with config snippet. Quick note on capacity: mitra-7b fits a single 80GB node with batching; echo-3b may need 2x smaller GPUs to keep cost constrained. Will propose a fallback to ozark-micro if capacity spikes.

lina: Starting quick latency run. Command: 
```
benchbot run --model mitra-7b --profile quick-latency --seq 512 --rps 5
```
I'll post results in ~30m. Also, can we prioritize the 5 prompt categories? I have: summarization, coding, Q&A, instruction-following, conversational.

benchbot: mitra-7b quick-latency results: p50=42ms/token, p95=120ms/token, throughput=180 tokens/s (single 80GB node, batch=8). No OOMs.

lina: perf looks okay for mitra-7b for our p95 target (<150ms). Will run echo-3b next.

echo-3b_owner (note in thread): echo-3b model weights are under the 'community' repo. Tagging here so infra has the exact artifact path: s3://models/community/echo-3b/v1.

benchbot: echo-3b quick-latency results: p50=68ms/token, p95=210ms/token, throughput=95 tokens/s (2x40GB nodes, batch=6). p95 exceeds target.

lina: Echo-3b needs quantization or a smaller sequence-length plan to hit p95 target. Suggest trying 4-bit quant + kernel tuning, or serve as a lower-tier model with traffic -> ozark fallback.

omar: SPDX scan done: mitra-7b metadata ok (Apache-2.0 like). echo-3b includes a clause in its README about 'non-commercial research only' — red flag. Need the full license text and the model card. Pls attach license file.

sasha: @omar — attaching echo-3b license (uploaded to legal folder). Can you confirm if restriction blocks hosted catalog? If so, we can still list it as 'dedicated-only' or 'private' if customer agrees.

omar: Received. From quick read: it is restrictive. Likely not allowed in hosted API. I'll file a formal review and propose acceptable deployment modes.

mike: For rollout plan: recommend canary 5% traffic -> monitor latency, error-rate, cost delta. Canary rollback to ozark-micro automatic on error >1% or p95 >200ms. Config PR targets that policy.

tara: Product note: if echo-3b can't be in hosted, we should hide it from public catalog and mark it as 'partner/private' so sales knows. I'll update the launch doc.

sasha: Action items and owners: 
- legal: formal review + deployment restriction verdict (omar)
- perf: try quant/opt for echo-3b and rerun (lina)
- infra: prepare canary config + fallback policy (mike)
- product: update launch doc & visibility rules (tara)
- eng-platform: dataset access for perf evals (assigned separately)

sasha: Can everyone post a quick ack + ETA in this thread? I want a gating readout by EOD tomorrow. :eyes: :white_check_mark:

mike: ack — infra PR draft by tomorrow noon.

lina: ack — echo-3b quant experiment by tomorrow afternoon.

omar: ack — formal legal memo by EOD tomorrow (if not earlier).

tara: ack — I'll update product doc and inform sales by EOD.

sasha: Great. If anything blocks, flag here and I'll escalate. Thanks all. :rocket:
